statement: The physically acquired wired 1302 HID descriptor declares top-level Mouse 0001:0002, Keyboard 0001:0006 and vendor ff00:0001 on one USB interface; lizard input 0x40 has five-byte mouse body, input 0x41 eight-byte keyboard body, and native report 0x42 is independent. sc26re implements report 40/41 generation; these declarations and replacement semantics do not prove when retail firmware emits or its exact mapping.
